rawMail.description: Headers, blank line, body. Untrusted end to end. Matches apf-mail-ingest's own MAX_RAW_BYTES (1 MB) — the two limits must agree, or a message the Worker accepts is silently refused one step later (found live 2026-09-16, HANDOFF 174).

receivedFrom.description: Transport identity (relay, mailbox), not the sender.
